lines: [announcer] This Friday, America will spend one hundred forty-nine thousand dollars online. Every. Single. Second.
[fast] In the time it takes me to say this sentence... about a million dollars. Gone.
[shocked] One hour? Five hundred and thirty-seven million dollars.
[deadpan] By midnight: twelve point nine billion. Online. In one day.
[sneaky] And that's not even the biggest day. Cyber Monday is expected to hit fifteen billion.
[confident] So that countdown timer on your screen? It's built for exactly this second.
[whisper] Since this video started... about seven million dollars. Every. Single. Second.
